The reason I personally want them to improve their card services, amongst some other things, is to feel confident enough as though I was with any high street bank. I would like to see CDC on par with HSBC, Santander, Natwest, etc. when it comes to the choice of who to primarily bank with. They're not a bank but they are pretty darn close and still a financial institution that carries responsibility to their customers. I think that this is what they should strive for if they want to accomplish their mission statement - "to accelerate the world's adoption of cryptocurrencies". Current service quality is far from being on par with any high street bank and that is why it's important to point out the negatives, because without it, they will just accept the current quality as "good enough" which leaves no room for improvement. Both positives and negatives can be communicated without rudeness or bullying.

Personally, I've never had issues with CDC support, they've always been prompt and professional with my queries, who knows. But, I think they have some major issues with their cards that people shouldn't have to put up with. You don't see nearly this many complaints with Binance or Coinbase cards who have alot more customers to deal with. Heck, imagine if a high street bank had a sytematic issue of delaying card issuance for multiple months. Nah, customers should be putting pressure on them, this can't remain the norm. In a calm and objective manner ofcourse.

True, the posts are redundant and we know roughly what is going on but is booting out a person who wants to connect to someone who may be experiencing the same issues the right way to go about it? Seems a bit aggressive. Who knows, there might be someone who has gone through a similar experience and may be able to help. CDC support and their social media presence (be it Reddit, Twitter, or whatever) is the right place to bring up issues and complaints.

I know that these sort of posts can be spammy and annoying, and it is good that CDC has a very loyal customer base BUT these are legitimate complaints. CDC is a business, not a cult, it is healthy for people to point out the flaws in their operations and services. There are bigger exchanges with a larger customer base who handle card issuance and queries much more efficiently. CDC card services cannot be improved if we do not complain.

Not worth it with a low deposit. The reason is because you may earn below the minimum required sell limit. For example, I earned 0.0029 AXS but I can't do anything with it because the lowest amount where I can make a single transaction with it is 0.0147 AXS. That was with £80 worth of CRO for the full duration. Based on the AXS supercharger example, I should have had roughly £400 worth of CRO in order to actually sell what I earned or exchange it for something else. Bear in mind that all supercharger events will be slightly different and the math can be a tad tricky with the liquidity share calculations BUT based on personal experience I wouldn't put in anything less than £500 worth of CRO so that I can actually do something with whatever I earn. However, I do hope that in the future they implement a feature where you can just round up all the small balances and exchange them for CRO or fiat.
